verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email provider, so importing mail history and contacts is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no import or migration feature for mail history or contacts. The IMAP/SMTP client connectivity (docs-8) lets a client access an AgentMail inbox, but it is not a documented import capability; using it to copy old mail across would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
